title: Dow tumbles 628 pts as Middle East oil surge, US-Canada trade war, and Fed fears hit markets
summary: Dow Jones fell 628.18 pts (-1.18%) to 52,786.07, S&P 500 -0.58% to 7,673.52, Nasdaq -0.32% to 26,421.41 on Sept 8. Triple headwinds: Houthi strikes on Saudi energy sent oil near $100; Canada's $27.6B retaliatory tariffs took effect; CPI data due later this week keeps Fed rate-hike bets elevated.
why: 美股三杀——中东地缘冲击、美加贸易战升级、美联储加息预期共振，港股次日开盘承压风险显著；持有期权的标的注意波动率走高。

title: China August exports surge 25%, trade surplus hits record $119.09B ahead of Xi-Trump summit
summary: China August exports grew 25% YoY (vs. 23.9% in July), driven by autos and high-tech goods. Trade surplus widened to a record $119.09B from $112.5B in July. Exports to the US rose 34.4% YoY; bilateral US-China surplus hit $29.2B. Imports up 28.2% (slightly below 30% estimate). Data comes ahead of an expected Xi-Trump meeting in late September.
why: 出口持续强劲印证中国制造业韧性，港股出口链及制造业相关标的受益；中美双边顺差扩大或增加谈判筹码，美中关系博弈依然是港股核心变量；持仓消费与互联网股受贸易摩擦间接影响需持续关注。

title: Memory stocks buck market selloff: Micron +6%, SanDisk +12%, SK Hynix +8% on Goldman note and AI demand
summary: On a broad market down day (Sept 8), AI memory stocks surged. Goldman Sachs flagged improving technicals; Dell's $95B AI server backlog confirmed insatiable DRAM/NAND demand. Micron's capacity reportedly fully allocated through end-2026. UBS raised HBM price growth forecast to 79% annually. Lynx Equity set PT $1,325 for Micron, $2,450 for SanDisk.
why: 内存供给吃紧持续，AI服务器需求过剩——对持仓SK海力士(南方两倍做多)、美光、闪迪直接利好；HBM定价上行对做空波动率策略中的covered call提供更高premium空间。

title: Intel jumps >10% on Northland upgrade ($120 PT), $20B equity raise, CPU price hike, and Terafab foundry upside
summary: Intel shares rose >10% on Sept 8, bucking the broad market sell-off. Northland Securities upgraded to Outperform ($120 target), citing Terafab foundry partnership with SpaceX/Tesla as a scale driver. Intel announced a $20B common stock offering at $95/share to fund capex. DigiTimes reported CPU prices could rise ~10% in early October. High-NA EUV milestone also announced with ASML.
why: 英特尔晶圆代工反转叙事持续强化，Terafab若落地将为持续亏损的Foundry业务提供规模化支撑；短期关注$20B股权摊薄影响；持有INTC相关期权的注意隐含波动率变化。

title: Palantir names Nebius preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner; integrates compute inside AIP enterprise perimeter
summary: Palantir and Nebius announced a strategic partnership on Sept 8: Palantir designates Nebius its preferred sovereign AI infrastructure partner, integrating Nebius's GPU compute and inference endpoints inside the Palantir enterprise perimeter. Partnership targets enterprise clients demanding data sovereignty over hyperscalers. Nebius stock (NBIS) jumped on the announcement.
why: Palantir持续扩大AI生态圈，Sovereign AI叙事再强化；对AIP平台高续费率预期有支撑；PLTR已连续大幅上涨，关注9月18日前后期权到期仓位是否过于拥挤，注意平仓风险。
